primary_metric: mean accuracy over 9 fixed held-out corruption conditions
prior_art_status: Core ingredients (symmetry-derived image features, augmentation for invariance, kernel methods incorporating invariances) are established; exact single exp(-gamma*flip-distance) appended scalar for this corruption benchmark was not found in the searched primary literature. Novelty remains unestablished.
limitations: Three small exploratory splits; no inferential claim.
The proposal ambiguously stated whether sigma=0.5 is normalized; implemented literally on normalized [0,1] pixels, producing substantial clipping.

Validation means: control [0.770969,0.793253,0.804395], flip [0.771278,0.792634,0.801300], permutation [0.771588,0.794491,0.802538]; the preregistered rule fails because flip beats control in only one seed and fails to beat permutation.
Held-out results are descriptive and do not override the failed validation rule.
The fixed random permutation is one draw per seed, so the feature ablation itself has sampling variability.
